description: Which companies of a sheet (or of the rows given) show a buying signal, read and checked in one call, free: the signals the sheet already has (its Sinal column, an imported signal column, the ERP and loyalty club columns), the Receita's events of each CNPJ through the Nock Registry (filial nova, capital aumentou, sócio novo, contrato público, saída do Simples or MEI, periodDays 7/30/45/60/90, 90 by default), Nock's job index (openings in the period, and the ERP a post names as the company's) and the answers Nock already keeps (loyalty club, competitors' club apps, ERP). What fires is written into the sheet as its signal cells, on every row of the company. Returns, per signal, how many companies show it with examples (the fact and its public evidence) and the monitor that keeps bringing it (feed), plus companiesWithSignal, companiesWithoutSignal and signalRows. paidChecks (loyalty_club for supermarkets, erp) check the companies with no kept answer, up to 30 per call within the call's time: without confirmed they are only quoted (paidQuote.maxCredits, status needs_confirmation); with confirmed true they run, and only the companies where the signal is found are charged (4 credits a loyalty club answer, 6 an ERP proved).

confirmed.description: true runs the paid checks a call without it quoted (paidQuote), with the same input.

paidChecks.description: Paid checks for the companies with no kept answer: loyalty_club (supermarkets: a competitor's club or none) and erp (the ERP the company runs). Quoted first; run only with confirmed.

periodDays.description: How far back a signal counts: 7, 30, 45, 60 or 90 days. Default 90.

rowIds.description: Only these rows' companies (the rows the person picked). Omit for the whole sheet.
